map.d_head 不整除怎么办？: What if d_head does not divide evenly?
map.→ 打开注意力头维度工具: -> Open the attention head dimension tool
map.不一定。头数增加提升并行关注不同子空间的能力，但 d_head 随之变小、每头容: Not necessarily. More heads improve the ability to attend to different subspaces in parallel, but d_head shrinks with them and the capacity per head becomes limited; beyond a certain point the returns diminish while compute cost keeps rising.
map.单层注意力参数量≈4·d_model²（Q/K/V/O 四个投影），与头数无关只: Per-layer attention parameters ~= 4 * d_model^2 (the four Q/K/V/O projections), independent of head count and tied only to the total dimension.
map.多头注意力把 d 维切成 heads 份并行计算，每头维度须整除，头数过多会让单: Multi-head attention splits the d dimensions into heads for parallel computation, and the per-head dimension must divide evenly; too many heads make each dimension too small and weaken expressiveness. Per-layer parameters consist of the four attention matrices 4d^2 and the two FFN layers 2d * ffn, which dominate memory and compute.
map.头数过多而 d_head 过小会限制每头表达能力，需权衡并行度与单头容量。: Too many heads combined with a very small d_head limits the expressiveness of each head, so parallelism must be weighed against per-head capacity.
map.每头维度 = d / heads；单层权重参数 ≈ 4d² + 2d·ffn: Per-head dimension = d / heads; per-layer weight parameters ~= 4d^2 + 2d * ffn
map.每头维度 d_head=d_model/h，需整除；常见 d_model=512: Per-head dimension d_head = d_model / h, which must divide evenly; a common case is d_model = 512, h = 8, giving d_head = 64.
map.输入隐藏维度与头数，计算多头注意力的每头维度及单层参数量，适用于 Transfo: Enter the hidden dimension and head count to compute the per-head dimension and per-layer parameter count of multi-head attention. Suitable for checking Transformer structure, model configuration and dimension alignment.
map.需调整 d_model 或头数使其整除，否则框架会报错或 padding 引入冗: d_model or the head count must be adjusted so it divides evenly, otherwise the framework errors out or padding introduces redundancy. Common combinations guarantee d_model % h == 0.
map.：d_model=768, h=12 → d_head=64。Q/K/V/O 各: : d_model=768, h=12 -> d_head=64. Each of Q/K/V/O is 768 x 768 ~= 590k parameters, so per-layer attention is about 4 x 590k = 2.36M parameters; this does not depend on h, only on d_model.
